1e:T4f9,According to Pegasystems' Form 10-K for 2025 and Form 10-Q for the third quarter of 2026, the company is defendant in Appian Corp. v. Pegasystems Inc. & Youyong Zou in Fairfax County, Virginia. A jury found in May 2022 that it had misappropriated Appian trade secrets wilfully and maliciously, and judgment of US$2,060 million was entered in September 2022. The Court of Appeals of Virginia reversed and ordered a new trial in July 2024 and the Supreme Court of Virginia affirmed that on 2026-01-08. The retrial is set to begin on 2027-01-11. On 2026-10-16 the court allowed Appian to present a reasonable-royalty damages theory, under which it seeks US$284.6 million and US$1.36 billion; the company states that it denies misappropriation and cannot reasonably estimate possible damages. The 10-Q also reports that two sets of securities lawsuits brought by investors who opted out of a settled class action were settled on 2026-09-18 and dismissed with prejudice in October 2026, that a shareholder derivative case was settled with court approval on 2026-06-30, and that a US$16 million loss was accrued for litigation settlements. The company is plaintiff in a separate defamation case against Appian in the District of Massachusetts, in which Appian has 4b:T4f9,According to Pegasystems' Form 10-K for 2025 and Form 10-Q for the third quarter of 2026, the company is defendant in Appian Corp. v. Pegasystems Inc. & Youyong Zou in Fairfax County, Virginia. A jury found in May 2022 that it had misappropriated Appian trade secrets wilfully and maliciously, and judgment of US$2,060 million was entered in September 2022. The Court of Appeals of Virginia reversed and ordered a new trial in July 2024 and the Supreme Court of Virginia affirmed that on 2026-01-08. The retrial is set to begin on 2027-01-11. On 2026-10-16 the court allowed Appian to present a reasonable-royalty damages theory, under which it seeks US$284.6 million and US$1.36 billion; the company states that it denies misappropriation and cannot reasonably estimate possible damages. The 10-Q also reports that two sets of securities lawsuits brought by investors who opted out of a settled class action were settled on 2026-09-18 and dismissed with prejudice in October 2026, that a shareholder derivative case was settled with court approval on 2026-06-30, and that a US$16 million loss was accrued for litigation settlements.
